ops.old: Whisk flour with cold lager to a light batter. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C until crisp. Mix sour cream with lime juice. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, the fish, a spoon of sour cream and some fresh salsa.
ops.new: Whisk flour with cold lager to a light batter. Dip 500g cod strips and fry at 180C until crisp. Mix sour cream with lime juice. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, the fish, a spoon of sour cream and some fresh salsa.

ops.old: Dip the flathead strips in the batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until crisp.
ops.new: Dip the cod strips in the batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until crisp.
